_notes: Synthetic test fixtures for prompt.md. Each case has raw input text (simulating either a full scraped JD or an OpenGraph-only fallback) and the expected normalized output. Free-text fields (description_summary, skills, city) are soft/advisory — the harness should not hard-fail on exact-string mismatches there, only on enum/boolean/number fields.

cases.raw_text: Senior Assay Scientist — Seaport Bio. Location: Boston, MA (Seaport, on-site). Seaport Bio recently closed our Series A and is building a next-generation oncology therapeutics platform. You will run high-throughput wet lab assays, develop cell culture protocols, and manage our vivarium operations. This is a 100% on-site bench role; no remote option. Compensation: $120,000 - $145,000/year.

Robotics Controls Engineer — Kendall Motion Labs. Office in Waltham, MA; hybrid, 3 days/week in office. We are a Series B company building autonomous warehouse manipulators. You'll work in our hardware lab running CNC-machined prototype actuators and cleanroom sensor calibration. Salary range $140,000-$165,000.

Founding Machine Learning Engineer — Kendall Motion Labs. You will be one of our first 10 employees, reporting directly to our CTO. Hybrid, 3-4 days/week in our Kendall Square, Cambridge office with hardware-in-the-loop test rigs for physical manipulation robots. Equity: 1.0%-2.0% for this early hire. $150,000-$180,000 base.
Customer Success Manager — Coastal SaaS. Fully remote, open only to candidates residing in Massachusetts. No physical office. We help mid-market retailers manage inventory with our SaaS platform.
Backend Software Engineer — Texas Startup Inc. Location: Austin, TX. On-site required, 5 days/week in our Austin office. Not open to remote candidates outside Texas.

Business Operations Generalist — BackBay Co. Boston, MA (Back Bay), hybrid 2 days/week in office. Join our small, fast-moving team across finance, people ops, and vendor management. No funding details mentioned in this posting.
Growth Marketer — Drift AI. Remote - US. We're a fully distributed AI SaaS startup, no physical office, team spread across the US. Open to candidates in any US state including Massachusetts.

Performance Marketing Lead — PixelFlow. Cambridge, MA (Kendall Square), hybrid 3 days/week in office. PixelFlow recently closed our Series A and is growing our enterprise SaaS platform for retail analytics. You'll own paid acquisition, SEO, and lifecycle email campaigns, and build out our growth marketing function from scratch. $95,000-$120,000 + performance bonus.

Senior Data Analyst — HarborMetrics. Boston, MA, hybrid 2 days/week in office. HarborMetrics is a Series B fintech analytics company serving regional banks. You'll build SQL/Python ETL pipelines, maintain executive dashboards, and support ad-hoc reporting for the leadership team. $110,000-$130,000.

Senior Fraud Detection Engineer — SentinelGuard Security. Boston, MA (Seaport), hybrid 3 days/week in office. SentinelGuard is a Series B company building AI-driven fraud and anomaly detection for financial institutions. You'll build and maintain gradient-boosted and anomaly-detection models for real-time transaction risk scoring — this is classical applied ML, not an LLM or computer-vision role. $160,000-$190,000.
